definitions.Type A: very passive: never bets, calls only with the King, otherwise checks or folds.
definitions.Type B: plays the equilibrium strategy: value-bets the King, sometimes bluffs with the Jack, checks the Queen, and calls with the Queen only some of the time.
definitions.Type C: very aggressive: bets and calls with almost any card.
definitions.Type D: adaptive: starts close to equilibrium, but bluffs with any card once the learner has folded to its bets often.
definitions.Type E: cautious: bets and calls only with the King, otherwise checks or folds.
